scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/exact-bun-bootstrap.ts --outfile dist/exact-bun-bootstrap.js --target bun && bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun --external @hasna/events --external @hasna/events/* --external @hasna/contracts --external @hasna/contracts/* --external pg && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --external @hasna/events --external @hasna/events/* --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external @hasna/mcp-harness --external @hasna/mcp-harness/* --external @hasna/contracts --external @hasna/contracts/* --external pg && bun build src/agent/index.ts --outdir dist/agent --target bun && bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --target bun --external @hasna/events --external @hasna/events/* --external @hasna/contracts --external @hasna/contracts/* --external pg && bun build src/sdk/index.ts --outdir dist/sdk --target bun --external @hasna/contracts --external @hasna/contracts/* && bun build src/index.ts src/storage.ts src/consumer.ts src/test-profile.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external @hasna/events --external @hasna/contracts --external @hasna/contracts/* --external @hasna/events/* --external pg && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir types
